Software Developer.title: Software Developer
Software Developer.overview: Build scalable backends, user interfaces, microservices, and distributed applications for modern software products.

skills.name: Data Structures & System Algorithms
skills.industry_relevance: Essential for algorithmic problem solving, code efficiency, and technical whiteboard interviews.
skills.expected_depth: Mastery of HashMaps, Balanced Trees, Graphs (BFS/DFS), Dynamic Programming, and Space-Time Complexity.

skills.name: Git & GitHub Collaboration Workflows
skills.industry_relevance: Industry software development is 100% team-based; branching, rebasing, pull requests, and merge conflict resolution are day-one essentials.
skills.expected_depth: Feature branching, cherry-picking, interactive rebasing, writing clean commit messages, PR reviews.

skills.name: RESTful API Design & Implementation
skills.industry_relevance: Crucial for connecting frontends to backend services, handling JSON payloads, status codes, authentication, and pagination.
skills.expected_depth: HTTP verbs, REST conventions, route validation, token authentication (JWT), error handling in FastAPI/Express.

skills.name: Docker & Containerization
skills.industry_relevance: Modern cloud applications run in lightweight containers to ensure consistency between development, staging, and production.
skills.expected_depth: Writing Dockerfiles, multi-stage builds, docker-compose orchestration, volume management, container networking.

skills.name: Modern Frontend (React & Tailwind CSS)
skills.industry_relevance: Full-stack developers must build responsive, dynamic, component-driven client interfaces.
skills.expected_depth: Component lifecycle, React hooks (useState, useEffect, useContext), responsive layouts with Tailwind, client-side routing.

skills.name: Production Database Engineering (PostgreSQL/SQL)
skills.industry_relevance: University covers basic relational theory, but industry requires indexing, query optimization, migrations, and ORMs.
skills.expected_depth: Joins, transactions, indexing strategies, ACID compliance, ORMs (SQLAlchemy/Prisma), query profiling.

skills.name: System Design & Scalable Architecture
skills.industry_relevance: Designing systems that scale to millions of users with caching (Redis), message queues (Kafka), and load balancers.
skills.expected_depth: Horizontal vs vertical scaling, caching patterns, CAP theorem, database sharding, microservices communication.

skills.name: CI/CD Pipelines & Automated Unit Testing
skills.industry_relevance: Automated test suites (PyTest/Jest) and deployment workflows (GitHub Actions) prevent regressions in production code.
skills.expected_depth: Unit and integration tests, mock objects, writing GitHub Actions workflows for linting, testing, and artifact deployment.

Data Analyst.title: Data Analyst
Data Analyst.overview: Transform raw business datasets into actionable decisions through statistical modeling, SQL transformations, and BI dashboards.

skills.name: Advanced SQL (Window Functions & Aggregations)
skills.industry_relevance: The #1 tested skill in Data Analyst interviews: calculating running totals, rankings, cohort retention, and multi-table joins.
skills.expected_depth: ROW_NUMBER, RANK, DENSE_RANK, LEAD/LAG, CTEs, self-joins, conditional aggregation (CASE WHEN).

skills.name: Python for Data Analysis (Pandas & NumPy)
skills.industry_relevance: Cleaning messy real-world datasets, handling missing values, reshaping schemas, and vectorized computations.
skills.expected_depth: DataFrames, groupby operations, pivot tables, handling NaNs, datetime manipulation, vectorization with NumPy.

skills.name: BI Dashboarding (Power BI / Tableau / Metabase)
skills.industry_relevance: Communicating insights to executive leadership and non-technical stakeholders through interactive visual metrics.
skills.expected_depth: DAX calculations, interactive filters, drill-through reports, executive KPI dashboards, storytelling with charts.

skills.name: Applied Statistics & A/B Hypothesis Testing
skills.industry_relevance: Validating whether a product experiment or marketing campaign produced a statistically significant lift.
skills.expected_depth: Null hypothesis testing, p-values, t-tests, chi-square, confidence intervals, sample size estimation, distributions.

skills.name: Exploratory Data Analysis & Feature Insights
skills.industry_relevance: Detecting anomalies, understanding correlation vs causation, and surfacing unexpected patterns in large datasets.
skills.expected_depth: Outlier detection, distribution skewness, Matplotlib/Seaborn visualization, correlation heatmaps.

skills.name: Business & Product Analytics (CAC, LTV, Retention)
skills.industry_relevance: Indian startups and enterprises value analysts who understand how data ties to revenue, churn, and unit economics.
skills.expected_depth: Cohort retention curves, Customer Acquisition Cost, Customer Lifetime Value, MRR/ARR, conversion funnels.

Embedded Systems Engineer.title: Embedded Systems Engineer
Embedded Systems Engineer.overview: Develop firmware, device drivers, and real-time operating system applications for microcontrollers, automotive, and IoT hardware.

skills.name: Embedded C & Bitwise Manipulation
skills.industry_relevance: Writing resource-constrained, high-performance C code with direct register manipulation and pointer arithmetic.
skills.expected_depth: Bitmasks, bit shifts, volatile qualifier, memory-mapped I/O, interrupt service routines (ISRs), stack vs heap.

skills.name: Communication Protocols (UART, SPI, I2C, CAN)
skills.industry_relevance: Interfacing microcontrollers with sensors, memory chips, wireless transceivers, and automotive ECUs.
skills.expected_depth: Timing diagrams, master-slave configurations, baud rate calculations, ACK/NACK signaling, packet framing, CAN bus IDs.

skills.name: ARM Cortex-M Architecture & Peripherals
skills.industry_relevance: The dominant architecture for commercial IoT, drones, and consumer electronics worldwide (STM32, NXP).
skills.expected_depth: NVIC interrupt priorities, Timers/PWM, ADC/DAC conversions, DMA channels, power sleep modes.

skills.name: Real-Time Operating Systems (FreeRTOS)
skills.industry_relevance: Managing deterministic multi-tasking, task priorities, and inter-task communication in safety-critical devices.
skills.expected_depth: Tasks, scheduler ticks, semaphores, mutexes, message queues, race condition prevention, priority inversion.

skills.name: Hardware Debugging (Oscilloscope & Logic Analyzer)
skills.industry_relevance: Diagnosing real hardware signal ringing, protocol timing errors, and electrical noise on circuit boards.
skills.expected_depth: Trigger modes, decoding I2C/SPI packets on logic analyzers, multimeter continuity/voltage verification, JTAG/SWD debugging.

skills.name: Schematic Interpretation & PCB Design Basics
skills.industry_relevance: Engineers must read component schematics, understand decoupling capacitors, pull-up resistors, and board layout rules.
skills.expected_depth: KiCAD schematic capture, footprint selection, power plane decoupling, ground loops, design rule checks (DRC).
